entries.title: 3D Sound Wave Tunnel
entries.description: A long transparent tube with a glowing ribbon of particles that pulses and ripples down its length to represent a music waveform, with amplitude-changing bulges, color-coded frequency bands, and a moving marker sphere that rides the crest with a trail.

entries.title: Floating Speakers and Rippled Air
entries.description: Several hovering box speakers emit expanding semi-transparent spherical shells that represent pressure waves, which overlap, interfere, and create brighter interference regions where shells collide, with a central meter showing combined loudness.

entries.title: Piano Keys to 3D Wavefield
entries.description: A row of white piano keys at the bottom triggers vertical oscillating columns of air above them, each column a semi-transparent cylinder that vibrates up and down with color-coded amplitude and leaves faint oscillation trails in a light room.

entries.title: Laser Sheet Through Music Fog
entries.description: A thin glowing plane (laser sheet) passes through a foggy box of tiny particles that oscillate in place according to a traveling sound wave, causing the particles to pulse and drift in waves while the sheet scans back and forth like a music visualizer.

entries.title: String Instrument Wave on a 3D Rope
entries.description: A taut rope stretched between two fixed posts vibrates in different standing wave modes when “plucked” by a moving sphere, with nodes labeled, antinodes glowing brightly, and overtones overlaying as semi-transparent colored curves along the rope.

entries.title: Water Surface Dancing to Beats
entries.description: A shallow transparent pool with a light-colored floor shows concentric surface waves emerging from several vibrating posts at the edges; waves collide, reflect from the walls, and form dynamic interference patterns colored by height.
